inputs.original_text: A baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line at JFK on Thursday, and an ICE agent stepped in as the family faced a crisis. DHS released footage of the response. Whatever people think about immigration policy, a uniformed officer taking responsibility and helping a family in a frightening moment deserves respect. We should value service and courage—not reduce every law-enforcement officer to a political symbol. A society that honors responsibility and protects families should recognize acts like this.
inputs.modified_text: A baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line at JFK on Thursday, and an ICE agent stepped in to help the family. DHS released footage of the response. Whatever the argument over immigration policy, this is what public service and personal responsibility look like: an officer responding to a family in crisis. We should be able to respect that without turning every uniform into a political target. A decent society honors those who protect families and keep order.
